About us

Founded in 2012, Purplle is one of India’s leading omnichannel beauty destinations. A strong platform with 1000+ listed brands, 60,000+ products, and 7 million+ monthly active users. Purplle expanded in 2022 with 6000+ offline touchpoints and 8 exclusive stores. In addition to offering third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its private D2C brands, FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae. Purplle has built a unique, highly personalized online and offline shopping experience for consumers by creating detailed user personas, enabling customers to test make-up, and recommending products based on personality, search keywords, and purchase behavior. In 2022, Purplle became India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by investors including Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA), Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures. With a 3,000+ strong team, Purplle is poised to be a leader in the burgeoning Indian beauty space.

The Purplle Garage 

What started as a hackathon at Purplle turned into a full-blown innovation sprint — bringing together builders across Tech & Product to solve real business problems.
After an exciting round of demos, the Top 5 teams earned their spot in The Garage Sprint — a fully sponsored, 1-week offsite work-cation, taking them away from the everyday hustle, giving them uninterrupted time and space to just build. 

And the results? Incredible. 
From AI-powered workflows to scalable tech solutions, teams took ideas and turned them into working MVPs — pushing boundaries and solving problems that matter. 

We later brought the entire Tech & Product community together for our quarterly Tech & Product Meet, where the winning teams were rewarded for their contributions to The Purplle Garage. 

A huge congratulations to our Winners 
 - Team Ignite and Runners-up: Team Sanjay and Team MI6
 
And a big shoutout to every team that participated and brought their ideas to life.
More than a hackathon, The Purplle Garage became a celebration of experimentation, collaboration and our builder culture. 

Here’s to creating the space to experiment, the freedom to build, and the teams that turn ideas into impact.

Public Cautionary Notice

It has come to our attention that certain individuals, entities, and third-party platforms are misusing the Purplle brand name, trademarks, and logos to promote fraudulent franchise and dealership opportunities.

We would like to clearly state that Purplle does not offer, solicit, or grant franchise or dealership opportunities for Purplle stores. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Purplle for such opportunities. Do not share personal or financial information, pay application/booking fees, or transfer funds to personal, third-party, or unofficial accounts.

We urge everyone to verify information through official Purplle channels and exercise caution before engaging with such offers.

Issued in the interest of the general public by Manash Lifestyle Private Limited.

"𝐆𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐬 𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐧'𝐭 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐭 𝐛𝐲 𝐡𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐞𝐥𝐥-𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐝 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐲'𝐫𝐞 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐭 𝐛𝐲 𝐡𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐞𝐱𝐜𝐞𝐩𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐡𝐬, 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐨𝐰𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐰."

For Vijit Anand leadership isn't about finding people who fit a mould. It's about identifying individuals with a unique edge, creating the right environment for them to thrive, and challenging them to become the best version of themselves.

When it comes to hiring, Vijit looks beyond résumés and rankings. He believes that what matters most isn't where someone stands today, but how far they've come and how relentlessly they're working to close the gap between who they are and who they can become. As he puts it, "Give me a spike: someone dangerously good at one thing, who builds systems instead of just clearing queues, and who'd rather be wrong out loud than right in silence."

That philosophy extends to onboarding as well. Instead of overwhelming new hires with presentations, Vijit believes in building confidence through trust, meaningful work, and empathy. A buddy, clear direction, and real ownership from the very first week create a stronger sense of belonging than any orientation session ever could.

His approach to feedback is equally straightforward. Honest conversations shouldn't wait for appraisal season. By combining candid feedback with unwavering belief in people's potential, he creates an environment where mistakes become learning opportunities, not setbacks. As he says, "The work gets judged. The person gets backed."

Keeping teams motivated, in his view, isn't about speeches or incentives—it's about designing an environment where people are trusted with meaningful challenges. By giving individuals autonomy, encouraging experimentation, and believing in their ability to solve bigger problems, he empowers them to consistently exceed their own expectations.

His leadership philosophy is built on a simple belief:
Hire for exceptional potential. Build with trust. Challenge people to grow, and they'll often surprise you with what they're capable of.
